w: Then there's the building. The plan includes about twenty-one billion dollars of capital over four years, about four point four billion of it in twenty twenty-seven. That is nearly twice what the City spent in twenty twenty-five. More than forty per cent of the new capital is for water and wastewater. Most of the work would go to contractors, in a tight construction labour market. And money that isn't spent isn't lost: it moves to later years. So the question is not only what Calgarians would pay, but how fast the City can build.
